mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, total_credits AS totalCredits, used_credits AS usedCredits, remaining_credits AS remainingCredits, last_recharged_at AS lastRechargedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_ai_credits WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_ai_credits (user_id, total_credits, used_credits, remaining_credits, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{totalCredits}, 0, #{totalCredits}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_ai_credits SET total_credits = total_credits + #{creditsToAdd}, remaining_credits = remaining_credits + #{creditsToAdd}, last_recharged_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_credit_logs (user_id, question_id, credits_used, action_type, description, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{creditsUsed}, #{actionType}, #{description}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, question_id AS questionId, credits_used AS creditsUsed, action_type AS actionType, description, created_at AS createdAt FROM ai_credit_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
